Welcome to Denton Community Primary School
Welcome to Denton Community Primary School & Nursery. The school has been at the heart of the village since it first opened its doors in 1969. We are a thriving and popular one-form entry school, and we are very proud of our strong sense of community.
The pages on this website offer a range of information about the school, and we hope you find it helpful and informative.
Can't see something you're looking for? Try our Statutory Information page.
